notes:
- **New: custom cue ball look** — pick a local image, drag and zoom to adjust the circular crop; settings are remembered and you can reset to the default cue ball at any time.
- **Improved toolbar layout** for easier operation.

history.notes:
- **Fixed an issue where the score occasionally did not show after clearing the table**; consecutive restarts now settle correctly.
- **Play again or quit directly after clearing the table** — no need to go back to the top toolbar.
- **Guide lines now show direction only** and no longer change with power; power is still controlled by the power bar.
- **Clearer release notes** with support for bold, headings and lists; previous versions are shown as well.

Leaderboard reset: after release, historical scores with an average time per ball of ≤ 6 seconds will be reset; affected players may re-challenge the board. This action is not a cheating determination and does not restrict future new scores.
Power now cycles back and forth: once power fills it drops automatically; hold the button to adjust repeatedly and release to strike; the new power bar shows the percentage and the rise/fall direction.
Table aspect ratio fixed at 2:1: fits wide, portrait and different resolutions, reducing the impact of screen ratio on gameplay.
Leaderboard shows more: added ball count and shot count; the window can display more entries.
Fixed possible mouse-reading anomalies when the lock screen or system UIs are switched; the game can continue afterwards.

New hidden-felt mode: the table background is hidden and the six pockets become your PC’s native recycle bin icons.
More discreet UI: the toolbar collapses automatically; hover the small eye to restore it; hold Shift to temporarily show the cue and aim line.
Better shot control: improved corner-pocket and guide-line accuracy, lowered tap power, longer power-up time.
Easier ranking access: added a leaderboard entry at the top; restored the percentage progress bar on the score card.
Fixed icon reading on some PCs and improved small-icon clarity.

New hidden-felt mode: when the felt is hidden, pockets become native recycle bins matching the size of desktop icons; turning the felt on still shows circular pockets.
The toolbar collapses automatically and keeps a small eye; hover to restore; hold Shift to temporarily show the translucent cue and guide line, release to hide; a brief how-to popup is shown when entering the mode.
Fixed thin-cut collision direction and corner-pocket entry detection, improving consistency between the guide line and the actual shot, and the “looks like it goes in but doesn’t” problem.
Fixed null-object errors when the desktop interface is not ready, corrected desktop icon window selection in some environments, and added diagnostic info for access-denied errors; access-denied and mixed-scaling dual-monitor setups still need user retesting.
README and donation window now state: donations are voluntary support for this project and include no extra features or dedicated support.

New global TOP 50 leaderboard, viewable right after clearing the table; shows personal best and average time per ball; your rank is highlighted and pinned at the bottom.
Redesigned the clear-table score card, highlighting global rank and the share of players beaten, with refined spacing, personal best and new-record styles.
Optimized the score window and share-button layout, supports resizing to available screen space, and fixed missing icons in official builds.
Reduced draw overhead of aim guide lines and multi-icon collisions for smoother performance on low-end PCs.

New Global Ranking: after clearing the table you can see your global rank, the share of players beaten and your personal best. Off by default; enable it yourself.
New clear-table summary window showing round time, average time per ball, ball count and shot count in one place.
Main window redesigned as a minimal horizontal bar; top title bar and status bar removed; all action buttons shown directly; draggable with saved position.
Ball count per round adjusted to 15–45; desktops with fewer icons are padded automatically, larger desktops use a subset.
Improved aim guide lines and icon sink animations; added a felt display toggle.
Improved update prompts and error messages; fixed a possible launch failure after local packaging.

New Global Ranking: after clearing the table you can see your global rank, the share of players beaten and your personal best. Off by default; enable it yourself.
New clear-table summary window showing round time, average time per ball, ball count and shot count in one place.

Improved aim guide lines and icon sink animations; added a felt display toggle.
Improved update prompts and error messages; fixed a possible launch failure after local packaging.

Fixed table misalignment and frames spanning screens in multi-monitor setups. The table, icon animations and shot prompts are shown only within the work area of the primary Windows screen.
Fixed a failure to start on some Windows PCs caused by a missing MFC runtime.
Fixed table misalignment and frames spanning screens in multi-monitor setups. The table, icon animations and shot prompts are shown only within the work area of the primary Windows screen.
New “icons remaining” stat, updated immediately on each sink. Shows 0 when the table is cleared and returns to the round’s ball count on a new round.

First public release. Turn your Windows desktop icons into a game of billiards — hold the left mouse button to power up, release to strike.
Supports ball and cushion guide lines, power indicator, round timing, sink statistics and clear-table summary; the desktop layout is restored on exit.
For Windows 10 / 11 x64, single-file executable.
